scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['node_modules', 'package-lock.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.clean:all: node -e "for (const p of ['node_modules', 'package-lock.json', 'src/server/node_modules', 'src/server/package-lock.json']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.reinstall: npm run clean:all && npm run server:install
